title: Code reviewer skill for recognizing and validating unauthenticated responses
summary: A new code reviewer skill was added to detect unauthenticated URL usage and validate the required response checks that must be enforced in those scenarios.
key_points: New skill for recognizing when code uses unauthenticated URLs
Specifies which response validation checks are mandatory for unauthenticated scenarios
Includes both bad and good code examples with documentation
Helps enforce security best practices in extension code
